resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Arabic source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Arabic pass identified 25 actionable terminology, grammar, formula, unit, and technical-clarity defects; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Arabic human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted for this cycle.

findings.summary: The Kirchhoff description did not name the conserved quantities precisely.
evidence: The previous text described conservation generally.
findings.resolution: Specified charge conservation at nodes and energy conservation in closed loops.

findings.summary: The circuit-terms heading was less natural than the standard Arabic technical term.
evidence: The previous heading used a literal rendering of circuit terms.
findings.resolution: Changed it to مصطلحات الدائرة.

findings.summary: The current-law example used an awkward branch-current construction.
evidence: The previous sentence did not clearly state that 3 A leaves through one branch.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the 8 A / 3 A / 5 A example in direct Arabic.

findings.summary: The voltage example used an inconsistent decimal representation.
evidence: The previous formula used a locale-inconsistent decimal form.
findings.resolution: Standardized the example as +8.0 V while preserving the formula variables.

findings.summary: The voltage-law explanation was literal and unclear about polarity.
evidence: The previous text did not clearly distinguish voltage rises and drops.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with standard Arabic circuit terminology and explicit polarity guidance.

findings.summary: The cell current-sharing warning was too vague.
evidence: The previous bullet did not clearly identify the factors controlling current sharing.
findings.resolution: Named internal resistance, contacts, wires, and switches.

findings.summary: The circuit-solving checklist used an indirect instruction.
evidence: The previous bullet did not directly instruct the reader to identify node voltages and branch currents.
findings.resolution: Changed it to a direct imperative instruction.

findings.summary: The TCR description narrowed the subject to an unspecified conductor.
evidence: The previous text described a conductor rather than a component.
findings.resolution: Used the broader and clearer term مكوّن.

findings.summary: The TCR introduction used an awkward size expression for temperature change.
evidence: The previous wording was a literal translation of small or moderate.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as تغير صغير أو متوسط في درجة الحرارة.

findings.summary: The positive-TCR bullet used the abbreviation without a clear Arabic expansion.
evidence: The previous text began معامل TCR موجب.
findings.resolution: Expanded it to معامل درجة الحرارة الموجب.

findings.summary: The alpha definition was grammatically incomplete.
evidence: The previous bullet did not clearly connect α to the material.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the definition as a complete Arabic sentence with the units preserved.

findings.summary: The trigonometry description used a literal and repetitive construction.
evidence: The previous description did not naturally connect angles, lengths, phase, and waveforms.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it in concise technical Arabic.

findings.summary: The geometry heading did not use the standard term for unknown sides.
evidence: The previous heading was a literal rendering of finding sides and angles.
findings.resolution: Changed it to إيجاد الأضلاع والزوايا المجهولة.

findings.summary: The sine example used an inconsistent opposite-side label.
evidence: The previous formula did not consistently use المقابل.
findings.resolution: Set the formula label to المقابل and preserved sin(30°).

findings.summary: The cosine example used an inconsistent adjacent-side label.
evidence: The previous formula did not consistently use المجاور.
findings.resolution: Set the formula label to المجاور and preserved the approximation.

findings.summary: The angle-unit heading was not concise Arabic technical wording.
evidence: The previous heading used an unnecessarily literal rendering.
findings.resolution: Changed it to الدرجات والراديان.

findings.summary: The radians formula left the unit name in English.
evidence: The previous formula ended with an English unit label.
findings.resolution: Localized the unit to راديان while preserving 180° = π.

findings.summary: The calculator-mode warning used an awkward literal sentence.
evidence: The previous paragraph did not clearly explain the degree/radian mismatch.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the warning and the full-turn equivalence in natural Arabic.

findings.summary: The latent-heat paragraph used a less precise phrase for specific latent heat.
evidence: The previous wording did not clearly identify L as specific latent heat.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the phase-change explanation and retained J/kg.

findings.summary: The heat-flux display name did not indicate density per unit area.
evidence: The displayed name was التدفق الحراري although q'' is a density.
findings.resolution: Changed it to كثافة التدفق الحراري.

findings.summary: The heat-flux summary did not state the per-area basis.
evidence: The previous summary described a transfer rate without area.
findings.resolution: Specified heat-transfer rate per unit area.

findings.summary: The heat-flux definition used total flow wording for a density.
evidence: The previous paragraph did not distinguish heat capacity from flux density per area.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the contrast with explicit per-unit-area wording.

findings.summary: The wire-gauge comparison table contained a corrupted AWG header.
evidence: The previous header was الفريق العامل المخصص.
findings.resolution: Restored the protected system names مقياس, AWG, SWG البريطاني, and BWG.

findings.summary: The resistance paragraph translated cross-sectional area as a geographic region.
evidence: The previous text used منطقة المقطع العرضي.
findings.resolution: Changed it to مساحة المقطع العرضي and clarified the AWG relationship.

findings.summary: The current-capacity instruction used القدرة الحالية instead of current-carrying capacity.
evidence: The previous bullet used a literal phrase that can be read as present power.
findings.resolution: Changed it to سعة التيار and retained the product-data and electrical-code warning.
